subject: Partial-term seat reassignment + mid-cycle invoice for Acme Health
messages:
From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Trevor Smith <trevor.smith@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: add 3 seats mid-cycle + reassign 2 seats (billing/proration)

Hi Dylan,

We're restructuring a small part of our product team and need to: 1) add three new active seats to our Redwood Dedicated plan effective Aug 16, and 2) reassign two existing seats from the "Platform" group to the "Integrations" group (no net decrease in seats, just reallocation). Our current billing cycle runs from Aug 1 — Aug 31. Can you confirm how you handle partial-month charges and credits for seat reassignments?

Also: a) do you issue a credit when a seat is moved between groups within the same customer account, b) how are VAT and tax line items handled for partial-month prorations (we're in the US but have an EU entity), and c) we'll need a pro-forma showing the mid-cycle charge so our AP team can approve the amendment — PO will follow.

Thanks — can you loop in billing if needed?

Emily Jones
Finance Manager, Acme Health
emily.jones@acmehealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Trevor Smith <trevor.smith@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: add 3 seats mid-cycle + reassign 2 seats (billing/proration)

Hi Emily — thanks for the details. Short answers up front: we can add seats mid-cycle (charged pro-rata) and we do not issue a credit for intra-account reassignment when the total seat count remains the same; however, if the reassignment also changes seat-level pricing (different billing profiles) there may be an adjustment. VAT treatment depends on the billing entity and billed address — if you have an EU VAT number for the entity we're invoicing, we can zero-rate the VAT where applicable.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll loop in our billing lead (Lauren) to produce a quick proration spreadsheet and a pro-forma invoice.
- Please confirm: (a) effective date for the +3 seats (you suggested Aug 16), (b) the billing entity for these seats (US or EU), and (c) preferred PO number to appear on the pro-forma.

I’ve attached a draft amendment template I usually use for these changes — we can populate and send for signature after you confirm PO/VAT info.

Attachment: amendment-draft-acme-2026-08-11.docx

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Emily Jones <emily.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: add 3 seats mid-cycle + reassign 2 seats (billing/proration)

Hi Emily / Dylan — looping in billing ops. I ran the numbers for an Aug 16 effective date. Summary below; see attached spreadsheet for the line-by-line math.

Summary (billing period Aug 1—31):
- Current seat rate (Dedicated): $200 / seat / month
- Add 3 seats effective 2026-08-16 -> charge = 3 seats * $200 * (16/31) = $309.68 (rounded)
- Reassignment of 2 seats: no net seat count change -> no credit if both seats remain on same pricing profile. If those two seats move to a lower-priced profile we'd issue difference as credit.
- Tax/VAT: based on the billing entity you provide. If billed to Acme Health USA (EIN on file) we will apply applicable US state tax where required. If billed to Acme Health EU (VAT ID provided), we will mark VAT as 0% where intra-community rules apply — we need legal entity name and VAT ID to support zero-rating.

We will:
1) Issue a pro-forma invoice for the pro-rata charge so AP can approve/submit the PO.
2) Post the one-off charge as an invoice dated Aug 16; it will appear as a separate line on your Aug invoice (next billing run).
3) If a signed amendment is returned, we'll update the subscription start/seat counts and generate the final invoice.

Attachment: proration-breakdown-acme-2026-08-11.xlsx

If you want the charge to be applied immediately (and paid now) rather than waiting for the Aug billing run, we can send a pro-forma with payment link.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Appreciate the quick turn.
Emily
